Validation passed with exit status 0.

**Definition quote (repeated, verbatim and in full), from the "Reproducibility" section:**

> Repeatability must be measured on unchanged records under the same evaluator model and definition, because even a fixed or zero sampling temperature does not guarantee identical semantic judgements.

## Evaluation complete

Wrote `output_evaluation.json`; `poetry run python scripts/validate_evaluation_schema.py --file output_evaluation.json --rubric rubric20-semantic` returned `VALID` with exit 0.

**Score: 82/88 — fixed 93.2% (÷88), normalized 93.2% (÷88).** No question was excluded, so both bases coincide.

| Category | Score | Max |
|---|---|---|
| Structural Completeness | 19 | 21 |
| Metadata Quality & Content | 20 | 21 |
| Technical Documentation | 23 | 25 |
| FAIRness & Accessibility | 20 | 21 |

**Applicability.** All four gate conditions resolved as met, so `excluded_max_points: 0` and `questions_not_applicable: 0`. Each conditional question carries `applicability_status` and `applicability_evidence` citing fields outside its own scoring set, per the anti-circular rule — notably Q11, which is applicable because `external_resources` (a Q14 field) names `https://github.com/AI-READI`, not because its own preprocessing fields are populated.

**Deductions, all evidence-based:** Q3=3 (exactly 7 keywords, band is count-decided); Q8=4 (no DPIA, empty structured slot, unpopulated governance contact); Q11=4 (conversion tooling unnamed/unversioned); Q13=4 (no errata; v1/v2 DOIs documented as no longer accessible); Q20=4 (measurement bias across eight imaging platforms recorded only as an anomaly, no AIO mapping).

**Semantic findings:** 13 issues — 3 failed consistency checks (self-contradictory `is_deidentified`; sensitivity flags false against a restricted-tier control regime; `versions_available` listing versions the same field calls inaccessible), plus 9 warnings and content-accuracy items. Correctness validations passed: DOI prefixes map to real registrars (10.60775 FAIRhub, 10.5281 Zenodo, 10.1038, 10.1136), all three NIH grant numbers are well formed, ORCID/ROR valid, RRID not present. Two arithmetic checks were run independently: file counts reconcile exactly (356,334 + 9 = 356,343), byte totals do not (419,614-byte shortfall, disclosed by the record).

Two things worth flagging about my own output rather than the record. First, the `method` value `claudecode_api` you supplied is in the schema's enum, so provenance passed through unchanged. Second, this is a single evaluation: the 93.2% is one draw from a runtime whose temperature is not exposed (recorded as `null`), and it is comparable only to scores from the same evaluator model and instrument digest with the same excluded-item set — a caveat I recorded in `metadata.score_basis_note` rather than leaving to the reader.
